Digital artist nohygiene creates surreal 3D characters that combine angelic imagery, early-internet aesthetics and intensely emotional scenes. Her recurring figures have oversized heads, metallic or pale bodies, long hair and wings. They appear alone, exhausted, in love or overwhelmed, while simple symbols such (Artvangarde)as hearts, fire and tears make their emotions immediately visible. The deliberately imperfect graphics recall early 3D animation, online avatars and old computer imagery, rather than the polished realism of contemporary CGI. Across her work, these strange digital beings (Artvangarde)become vessels for very human feelings love, loneliness, anxiety, desire and emotional vulnerability. #art #loveyou #artist #niche #heart

For each idea, identify the target audience, the problem it solves, a suggested selling price, and why someone might purchase it.” ⚫ PROMPT 2: CREATE THE PRODUCT CONTENT “I want to create a [digital product] for [target audience]. Focus on attracting beginners who would benefit from my product without making unrealistic income claims.” ⚫ PROMPT 6: CREATE A 7-DAY MARKETING PLAN “Create a beginner-friendly 7-day marketing plan for launching my [digital product]. If I were starting my Etsy digital product shop from scratch today, these are the FIRST 5 products I’d consider creating in Canva! 👀💻 And no, you don’t need to be a professional designer to get started. 1️⃣ Editable invitations 🎉 Birthday parties, baby showers, bridal showers, and other celebrations all need invitations. I love this idea because you can create designs for specific occasions and offer customers a way to personalize them. 2️⃣ Budget planners 💰 People want simple ways to organize their money. Think monthly budget worksheets, bill trackers, and savings challenges that help make managing finances feel less overwhelming. 3️⃣ Meal planners 🥗 Busy families need help figuring out what to cook every week. A printable meal planner with a grocery list can solve a real everyday problem. 4️⃣ Habit trackers ✨ From drinking more water to building a morning routine, habit trackers give people a simple way to monitor their progress. You can even create versions for specific goals. 5️⃣ Cleaning checklists 🧹 Daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning checklists can help people stay organized without having to remember everything themselves. Here’s something I’ve learned from creating and selling my own digital products on Etsy: Simple doesn’t mean people won’t buy it. One of my first Etsy listings was a five-page Bible study printable. It took time to gain traction, but lately it’s been getting consistent sales. That experience reminded me that creating something useful for a specific audience matters more than making something overly complicated. ✨ My advice? Pick ONE product idea and focus on making it genuinely helpful before moving on to the next. 🎁 Still not sure what to create?
